name: LinkFormat
description: Contains properties and methods that apply to linked OLE objects, linked pictures, and IIRC media objects.
example:
For Each sld In ActivePresentation.Slides

    For Each sh In sld.Shapes

        If sh.Type = msoLinkedOLEObject Then

            If sh.OLEFormat.ProgID = "Excel.Sheet.12" Then

                sh.LinkFormat.AutoUpdate = ppUpdateOptionManual

            End If

        End If

    Next

Next

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: SourceFullName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name and path of the source file for the linked OLE object. Read/write.

properties.name: AutoUpdate
properties.description: Returns or sets the way the link will be updated. Read/write.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the specified linked OLE object.

methods.name: BreakLink
methods.description: Breaks the link between the source file and the specified OLE object, picture, or linked field.
